'''Crix Yarrow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] clerical worker who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Just because some crim...crimi... bad guy wantszh to control Mos Eisley, that's not something that I can do anything about. It's not like we don't have out own problemszh or anything!|Crix Yarrow, to an entertainer|<ref name="SWG:TEL" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Crix Yarrow served as an aide to [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the city and the mayor were in trouble because of attacks of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. In fact, the attacks were part of a plot of the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to pressurize the mayor and eventually take control of the city. During that time, Crix Yarrow visited [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] and stayed in a local [[Bestine Hotel|hotel]]. During his visit, he watched an [[entertainer]] perform for him. However, the entertainer was sent by [[Anetia Kah'ryn]] and was actually there to learn some information from Crix about the sinister plot being carried out in Mos Eisley. Anetia, a performer herself, found that patrons were more willing to divulge information after they have been entertained. Indeed, Crix agreed to speak to the entertainer, and simply revealed that there was some criminal boss who wanted to control Mos Eisley. Unfortunately, that was all the information he knew. Anetia Kah'ryn was finally able to discover the truth and expose the whole plot to Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt.<ref name="SWG:TEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNobleMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Crix Yarrow]]
Crix Yarrow was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Crix Yarrow was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of a quest given by Anetia Kah'ryn to beginner players who had chosen a career of "[[W:c:swg:Entertainer (pre-NGE)|entertainer]]."<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> During each server reset, his appearance and [[Species/Legends|species]] would fluctuate, but he was consistently depicted as a male.<ref name="SWG:TEL" />
